title: plantago major f. scopulorum
intro: Plantago major f. scopulorum, commonly known as Rocky Mountain or Western Plantain, is a subspecies of the Plantago major plant, a perennial herb native to western North America. The leaves and roots of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation and pain, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Plantago major f. scopulorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include mucilaginous and expectorant properties, which can help soothe respiratory issues and promote digestive health.
